ai.title: npm-app client refreshes usage after login
ai.summary: The npm-app client now calls getUsage() after a successful login instead of returnControlToUser(), so usage state is refreshed in the login path. The showUsageWarning(referralLink) call in the usage-update block is commented out, preventing the warning from firing during that refresh. The login path still resets lastWarnedPct to 0 before calling getUsage(). The change is limited to npm-app/src/client.ts.

eli5.text: After you sign in, the app now refreshes your usage data instead of jumping straight to the main screen, so any credit or subscription details load right away on the login path. You won't see any pop-up warning appear when that refresh happens, even if your usage is high. This affects anyone who logs into the app using the login flow.
